name: PASTIS: Agricultural Parcel Panoptic Segmentation Benchmark
description: PASTIS (Panoptic Agricultural Satellite Time Series) is a remote sensing benchmark dataset curated by the LASTIG laboratory at IGN (Institut National de l'Information Géographique et Forestière), France, published at ICCV 2021. The benchmark consists of 2,433 multi-spectral satellite image time-series patches (each 128x128 pixels at 10m/pixel spatial resolution with up to 70 observation dates) acquired by Sentinel-2 across four diverse agro-ecological regions in France. The dataset encompasses 124,422 individual agricultural parcel instances annotated with exact parcel instance IDs and 18 crop type semantic classes, establishing a standard benchmark for satellite panoptic segmentation and temporal attention networks.
